integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled verifier checks algebraic identities and numerical sanity only; finite numerical sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Local first-order asymptotic in the exponent only; it does not establish exact minimizers for all larger exponents, sharpen the perturbed c-epsilon problem, or improve the full finite-horizon convergence theorem by itself. A closely related recursive-composition preprint could not be inspected from its full arXiv text in the available source path, so its abstract and detailed scientific summary were compared and the residual risk is recorded.
title: Sharp first-order stability constant for the silver inequality
